Package org.tasktide.engine.traversers

Class WorkItemTraverser

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.traversers.WorkItemTraverser
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideWorkloadTraverser<WorkItem>, TaskTideWorkerUnit<WorkItem>
public class WorkItemTraverser extends Object implements TaskTideWorkloadTraverser<WorkItem>
Class to hold logic for fetching a workload from the TaskTideServiceManager. Utilizing the TaskTideEngineObserver, ItemTaskTraverser, and ItemTaskExecutor to handle how workload is consumed.
